content.title: The Grand Entrée
content.story: The circus performers need fuel for their spectacular acts. Your troop's field kitchen is now the Circus Commissary — responsible for feeding the cast of the Greatest Show on Earth. The Ringmaster has challenged every troop to prepare a camp-cooked entrée worthy of the Big Top. Tend your fire, sharpen your skills, and make something memorable.
content.challenge: Prepare a camp-cooked entrée using Scouting field cooking methods. Judges score on taste, presentation, technique, Scout participation, and theme creativity.
content.description: Each troop prepares one hot entrée using camp cooking equipment (Dutch oven, camp stove, open fire, or similar field method). Scouts do the cooking — adult leaders may assist with fire safety only. Judges visit each troop's camp kitchen during the judging window, taste the dish, and score it. Troops provide a written recipe card at the time of judging.
rules: Scouts must do the cooking — adult assistance limited to fire safety
One entrée per troop, served hot to the judge panel
Must use camp cooking methods — no household appliances
Serving size: enough for all judges to taste (minimum 2 oz per judge)
Provide a written recipe card describing the dish and cooking method
All ingredients must be food-safe and pre-prepped within camp food-handling standards
Dish must be ready and presented during the designated judging window
content.time_and_scoring:
Judges visit each campsite during the designated judging window (1–2 hour block announced at check-in).

Scoring (100 points total):
- Taste & Flavor: 0–30 pts
- Presentation & Appearance: 0–20 pts
- Camp Cooking Technique: 0–20 pts
- Scout Participation (Scouts cooking, not adults): 0–20 pts
- Circus / Theme Creativity: 0–10 pts

Tiebreaker: Judges' discretion.
content.setup: Announce judging window at check-in. Assemble judge panel (2–3 adults). Judges carry scoring sheets and move from campsite to campsite in sequence. Bring water and plain crackers as palate cleansers.
content.reset: Judges move to next campsite. No physical reset.
content.staffing: 2–3 adult judges. Score independently; average or discuss at end.
content.supplies_text:
Scoring sheets (1 per judge per troop): 1 pad
Pens: 1 per judge
Water bottles: 1 per judge
Plain crackers (palate cleansers): 1 sleeve
Clipboards: 1 per judge
Summary tally sheet: 1
